&Amount = RustCallEchoProbe(1.235) + RustCallEchoProbe(2.001)
msg(&Amount.ToString().Trim(), status)
&Flag = RustCallPositiveProbe(&Amount) Or RustCallPositiveProbe(RustCallEchoProbe(99))
If &Flag
msg("1", status)
Else
msg("0", status)
EndIf
&Amount = RustCallPairProbe(RustCallEchoProbe(3.125), RustCallEchoProbe(4.001))
msg(&Amount.ToString().Trim(), status)
&Amount = 0
Do While RustCallPositiveProbe(RustCallEchoProbe(1)) And &Amount < 2
&Amount = &Amount + 1
EndDo
msg(&Amount.ToString().Trim(), status)
